olivia-csm: Flag: SolaraBank MAU down ~60% in 10d. Renewal ~4w. Champion (Lead Data Sci) left last week. Need triage + fast playbook. @kai-sales any competitor activity?

kai-sales: They asked for a benchmark vs LumaAI yesterday. Procurement may push decision fast.

noah-eng: Telemetry shows rate-limit 429s and occasional 504s after a spike in prompt length. Log snippet: ```
2024-07-12T08:14:02Z solara-11 429 rate_limit
```

olivia-csm: Proposed immediate actions: 1) offer 7-day Dedicated trial to validate peak traffic; 2) ops reproduce 429s with sanitized prompts; 3) commercial prepare pilot credit and NDA. Owners?

noah-eng: I can run repro. Need sample prompt schema or sanitized examples. ETA 24h.

kai-sales: I'll draft pilot terms and push NDA. Tentative quick call Wed.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-13000 created: solara-11 high-429. Assigned to noah-eng.

olivia-csm: Great — I'll prep a 1-pager perf brief comparing gen latency & token-cost vs competitor for the call. Tagging: @noah-eng (repro), @kai-sales (commercial).

noah-eng: Will post repro results and p95/90 latency numbers once ready.

olivia-csm: Thanks team. Goal: convert trial to short reserved commit if metrics align. :rocket:
